evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 說文釋形；注音；漢語拼音；釋義
evidence.text: The entry for 囧 gives modern Mandarin jiǒng and cites Shuowen’s account of a window form, including the historical report that Jia Shi Zhong read it like 明. The MOE 明 entry gives míng. These establish the current Mandarin readings, not an ancient phonetic correspondence. The historical phonetic note is an old report, not an independently established reconstruction of the window’s name.
evidence.title: B00484 囧 — Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The entry identifies 朙 as a variant of 明 and quotes Shuowen’s analysis of 朙 as 月 plus 囧, with 明 described there as its ancient form. This source supports the explicitly stated relation between those whole graphs; it does not establish the date or exclusive ancestry of the 日月 form.
evidence.title: A01784-001 朙 (明) — Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: Shuowen.org, 說文解字 囧 entry
evidence.field: 囧 entry; quoted 說文 and 段玉裁注
evidence.text: The page gives Shuowen’s description of 囧 as a window form and its phonetic note 讀若獷, alongside Jia Shi Zhong’s report 讀與明同. Duan Yucai’s later note likewise treats the 明 comparison as a reported reading. This records historical lexicographic claims; it does not independently prove the sound of the depicted object or demonstrate 囧’s phonetic role in 朙.
evidence.title: 說文解字「囧」

evidence.text: The opened entry lists Modern Standard Mandarin jiǒng and Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese *k-mraŋʔ (system 1.1, 2014). This is a secondary reference; it supports the reading transcription shown there but is not evidence that the component’s ancient object name was recoverable.
evidence.title: 囧 — 维基词典

evidence.field: 古文字字源；上古音 comparison
evidence.text: The entry presents 朙 as 囧 plus 月 and compares Old Chinese 囧 *kʷaŋʔ with 明 *mraŋ, while proposing a phonetic role for 囧. This differs from Baxter–Sagart’s 囧 *k-mraŋʔ. The differing transcriptions belong to different reconstruction systems and should not be merged; neither entry by itself resolves how the proposed phonetic analysis accounts for the sound difference.
evidence.title: 朙 — 维基词典

gaps: Current readings are verified from the opened MOE dictionary entries, but the required official Unihan character-specific click-through records remain inaccessible. The tracked HSK 1 extract contains neither character, and the full local Unihan source was absent.

The requested exact Baxter–Sagart local TSV cross-check could not be repeated because that dataset file is absent from this checkout. The dossier’s supplied transcription is retained only as prior packet material, not newly verified local evidence.

The sound role of 囧 in 朙 remains source-reported rather than demonstrated here. Shuowen preserves a historical claim that 囧 was read like 明, while Baxter–Sagart transcriptions differ; the depicted window’s original spoken name has not been independently recovered.
